contexts.text: Some (of the infernals) appear as monsters. AC 4623:2. AC 4839:end, Explained. AC 5057:end. AC 5302:2.
In the light of Heaven (the infernals) appear as monsters. AC 6605:end. AC 6626. AC 6626:end. HH 80:end. HH 131:2. AE 554:3.
They then appear to themselves as monsters.
In the Hells... are forms of hatred and revenge; thus such monsters as cannot be described.
If a man is evil, he appears (to the Angels) as a monster, deformedly according to his evil.
Their bodies are monstrous.
At the openings which are called the gates of Hell, there for the most part appears a monster, which represents in general the form of those who are therein.
As soon as anything of the light of Heaven is let in, their human forms are turned into monstrous ones, such as they are in themselves...
The Church would then appear as one body with a number of heads upon it; thus not as a man, but as a monster.
A natural man, who has become sensuous through evils and the derivative falsities, in the Spiritual World in the light of Heaven appears... as a monster...
In proportion as a man does not receive (the love and wisdom from the Lord), he becomes a monster after death.
Hell is in... a monstrous human form...
He then commingles holy with profane things, and becomes... such a monster.
Hell constitutes one monstrous man.
Everyone in Hell is in the form as of a man, although monstrous; and all the fibres and vessels in it are inverted.
In its form Hell is like a monstrous man, whose soul is the love of self and Own intelligence...
All (satans and devils, in the light of Heaven) as to their faces and bodies, appear as monsters; but in their own light... not as monsters, but as men.
If a Church is in truths falsified, it appears (before the Lord) as a monstrous man. AR 601:2.
Suddenly there appeared a monster rising out of the earth... exactly like the beast...
As these see nothing of what is just, in Heaven we contemplate them not as men, but as monsters. Described.
All there are so conjoined, that... the universal Hell represents one monstrous devil.

Hell (before God) is as one giant which is a monster; and therefore to act against one evil and the derivative falsity, is to act against that monstrous giant... which no one can do except God... TCR 123:end.
Instead of the serpent, there was seen a monstrous man...
A fourth table sometimes appeared there, on which were seen monstrous things in various forms...
When any Hell is opened, or when any devil appears thence, he appears monstrous according to the quality of the Hell. Described. SE 4629:5.
Those who are evil, ... as to the face, when seen in the light of Heaven, appear... as monsters of various deformity. SE 4718.
In proportion as he rejects, suffocates, and perverts the truths and goods of the Word... he is a monster, and not a man...

As (the Moravians) went away, they appeared as monsters... and this monstrous [appearance] was increased even to their entrance beneath the earth... and when they came thither, the monstrosity remained, and appeared before the eyes of themselves and their brethren.
Those whose love is from the sun of the world... do indeed appear in the Spiritual World as men; but in the light of Heaven as monsters.
